svg.title: The record files of a run
svg.desc: The run folder, outside the repository, holds plain files; line 1 of each record is its STATUS line. The manager writes the briefs (_common.md, read first, and one _<role>-assignment.md per role) and _launch.md, the launch table with your Yes: line, and keeps the settings files and the duty list in _control/, which no role may read. After the launch the spec-writer, only when no spec exists, logs Spec: written in spec-log.md; the planner logs each task written in plan-log.md; the critic files C and A findings in critique.md; the builder logs Task N done and V fixed in build-log.md; the verifier files V findings with their repro in verify.md, for each commit; when all are verified, the judge writes VERDICT: on line 2 of judge.md. The critic's C and A ids, the builders' B ids and the verifier's (plan) and (spec) V ids are answered in critique-response.md, by the planner or the plan fixer. The watcher starts each fresh session and revives a stopped one, keeps the registry in _control/ and logs to _watch.log. A role session writes its handoff-<role>.md at a unit's end, and the fresh session reads it first; a cause shared by two findings becomes a rule in lessons.md, which the planner and the builders read before each task; at its end each role writes a *.summary.md in English. You read those summaries and the STATUS lines (head -1 <run>/*.md).
